messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a p95 step on /v1/generate around 03:14–03:22 UTC. p50 steady, p99 mostly flat. anyone seen this? :thinking:
maria: same. looks tied to a quota-triggered fallback for tenant 'alpha'. p95 +~120ms. p99 barely budged. :eyes:
sam_k: can you share the grafana range/URL? i'll grep router logs.
alex: dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/d/endpoint-latency -> range 2024-07-12 03:10:00–03:25:00 UTC
sam_k: quick log grep shows many retries and backend_time spikes on eu-fallback. example lines:
```
2024-07-12T03:14:12Z tenant=alpha endpoint=/v1/generate backend_time_ms=340 route=eu-fallback retry=1
2024-07-12T03:14:13Z tenant=alpha endpoint=/v1/generate backend_time_ms=360 route=eu-fallback retry=1
```
sam_k: looks like retries are recorded as separate samples in our telemetry. that will lift p50/p95 but may not shift p99 if tail requests unchanged.
jen_dev: FYI the console uses tdigest merging with a 60s decaying window for rollups. lots of midtail mass can push p95 quickly while p99 stays. possible math artifact.
maria: also KV-cache hit fraction dropped during fallback — many requests lost prefix cache and got slightly slower. explains median-ish rise, not tail.
ops-bot: [alert] RouteFallbackPolicyAlert: eu-fallback weight increased to 0.48 for tenant alpha at 2024-07-12T03:13:57Z; quota exhaustion detected.
alex: action list: 1) sam run staged flood to reproduce, 2) eng-platform investigate tdigest+decay artifact, 3) debate whether to exclude retry samples from percentiles.
jen_dev: quick thought — excluding retries from pctl calculation improves UX but changes SLO meaning. we'd need an opt-in flag on SLO dashboards and docs.
maria: could we instead surface a sample-origin badge (primary vs fallback vs retry) on latency panes? less policy-change and immediate UX signal.
sam_k: running staging replay (small payloads -> saturate primary -> force fallback). will post metrics in ~8m.
sam_k: staging results: KV-cache hit dropped 12% -> 94% miss; p95 pattern replicated. traces: https://traces.internal/0xdeadbeef
alex: solid repro. jen, can you validate whether the tdigest decaying window amplifies p95 for this pattern?
jen_dev: confirmed: when many ~300–400ms samples enter window at once, tdigest centroids shift and p95 jumps while p99 unaffected. merging behavior + decay weighting is the cause.
alex: tentative mitigation: annotate dashboard with fallback-trigger note and add sample-origin column. longer term RFC: opt-in SLO semantics for retry-exclusion or marking retry samples.
maria: agree. PR for dashboard annotation and badge would help immediate clarity.
jen_dev: filing RFC for opt-in retry exclusion, will propose default off and migration docs.
ops-bot: [info] Ticket created: ENG-2345 "opt-in retry-sample-exclusion for percentile calcs"
alex: thanks team. follow-ups: - sam attach staging run artifacts to ticket - jen attach small writeup on tdigest windowing - ops to add dashboard transient annotation.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
